description: One digit of the nth look-and-say term. The index starts at 0. Term 5 is 111221, so index 3 is 2. An index past the end is rejected. n runs from 1 to 25. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/look-say-digit
